assumptions: TI OPAx197 Final 1.3 typical model with explicit dual wrapper; no generic fallback.
Source resistance is 0.5 ohm supply and 1 kohm sensor; no PCB parasitics or capacitor ESR included.
R_TERM/C_TERM are populated bench termination; cases represent changed total equivalent termination.
Test/output headers are open. No ADC acquisition or instrument loading is claimed.
Below 4.5 V the vendor model is outside operating specification; startup traces are diagnostic, not cold-start qualification.
